answer: In the Proof of Agent network, sybil resistance is achieved by cryptographically entangling challenge tasks with future unbiasable beacon pulses from the Threshold BLS randomness beacons using commit-reveal schemes in the drand quicknet architecture. Each challenge task is bound via a zephyr cipher to the unpredictable pulse of the beacon, which prevents automated sybil swarms from pre-computing solutions or performing offline farming as they lack access to the real-time unbiased randomness required for validation.
